title.en: Change the environment, not your willpower

en: Focus is easier when the environment does the work: one thing on the desk, phone out of sight, notifications off.
A start ritual signals the brain it is time to work — the same small action every time.
Active ignoring: keep a written list of intrusive thoughts to park, not fight. Writing them down lets you return to them later instead of circling them now.
Choose three environment changes for your main work spot. Write them as concrete actions.
Apply the three changes and keep a park-list for one week.
What is likely to get in the way this week, and what will you do when it happens?
